decisions.statement: A line is appended rather than written over.
A line holds what was put to the model and what the model answered.
A line is written where a test answers yes rather than on every run.
A line names the rule judged and the seat the turn was under.
Lines are kept outside the commit.
No page states its own lines here.
Nothing here says whether the yes was right.
A yes that cannot be recorded is not a turn that is let through.

definition: a turn a test answered yes on, one line appended as that turn is judged
